_comment: Website-only presentation extras, keyed by DOI. image paths are relative to the site root. desc_html may contain <strong>/<a> tags.

10.21203/rs.3.rs-9177620/v1.desc_html: Supersolids are an exotic macroscopic quantum phase that exists in ultracold atomic gases and III-V semiconductors at cryogenic temperatures. We experimentally demonstrate exciton-polariton supersolids at room temperature.

10.1038/s41565-025-02118-5.image: images/publications/Excitonic negative refraction mediated by magnetic orders.jpg
10.1038/s41565-025-02118-5.image_alt: Excitonic negative refraction mediated by magnetic orders
10.1038/s41565-025-02118-5.desc_html: We report the first excitonic negative refraction. This work is featured in Phys.org, Mirage News, EurekAlert!, Sciencenet (科学网), 星島頭條, 明報.

10.1002/adma.202309015.desc_html: Interacting topological bosonic systems exhibit fundamentally distinct behaviour to their fermionic counterparts. We report the first topological parametric oscillators based on a Dirac-vortex nano-electro-mechanical cavity.

10.1038/s41467-024-46641-w.desc_html: Vortex strings are hypothetical topological defects in the geometry of spacetime in cosmology. We report the first experimental observations of vortex string chiral modes using a meta-material system.

10.1038/s41377-023-01290-4.image: images/publications/Room-temperature continuous-wave Dirac-vortex topological lasers on silicon.jpg
10.1038/s41377-023-01290-4.desc_html: We report the first Dirac-vortex microcavity laser that harnesses an auxiliary orbital degree of freedom. This work is featured in Light: Science & Applications 13, 64 (2024), Phys.org, and Sciencenet (科学网).

10.1002/lpor.201900087.image: images/publications/Topological photonic integrated circuits based on valley kink states.jpg
10.1002/lpor.201900087.desc_html: We demonstrate topological photonic integrated circuits. This work is featured as cover article.

10.1038/s41565-021-00868-6.image: images/publications/Nanomechanical topological insulators with an auxiliary orbital degree of freedom.jpg
10.1038/s41565-021-00868-6.desc_html: We report a topological system with an auxiliary orbital degree of freedom. This work is featured in Nature Nanotechnology 16 (5): 487-489 (2021).

10.1063/1.4945715.desc_html: We propose a new design of on-chip isolator using photonic spin-orbit interaction. This work is featured as cover article and selected by Optics & Photonics News (OPN), The optical Society's monthly news magazine, as one of the world's 30 most clearly communicated breakthroughs in optics in 2016.
